channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: TikTok is revamping its pay structure to reward high performers
item.description: TikTok and ByteDance are upping performance bonuses and other incentives for strong performers as they look to retain talent in 2026.

item.title: We don't know why Bari Weiss pulled a '60 Minutes' story — here's why that matters
item.description: The new head of CBS News has been immersed in politics since she started. So of course her call to hold a story will be viewed from a political lens.

item.title: Why are visa workers getting stuck overseas? Here's what to know.
item.description: Extending an H-1B visa used to mean a quick trip abroad. Now it can mean getting stranded, as consular officers review applicants' social-media posts.

item.title: ChatGPT's year-end recap is here — and it tells you how many em-dashes you exchanged
item.description: OpenAI released a 2025 recap rundown called "Your Year with ChatGPT," which tells users which day they chatted the most and awards an archetype.

item.title: Google tells staff it will ramp up green card applications again in 2026. Here's who won't be eligible.
item.description: PERM applications at Google will ramp up in 2026, affecting visa holders seeking green cards and permanent residency.

item.title: Trump says new 'Trump-class' battleship with railguns, lasers, and hypersonic missiles will be added to 'Golden Fleet'
item.description: President Donald Trump said they would be "AI-controlled" and he said that the design would be led by the US Navy with his aesthetic input.

item.title: California regulator reviews Waymo stalls during San Francisco power outage
item.description: The California Public Utilities Commission is looking into Waymo vehicles that stalled on Saturday during a San Francisco power outage.

item.title: James Cameron says getting fired from his first directing job led him to write 'The Terminator'
item.description: "Would I have come up with that story if I didn't have those constraints? I don't know," James Cameron said.

item.title: Jim Beam temporarily closes a Kentucky bourbon distillery amid a tough time for the American distilled spirits industry
item.description: Distilled spirits have seen a major decline in exports to big markets like Canada, and domestic consumption isn't making up for the shortfall.

item.title: A cheaper, easier-to-use version of Wegovy is coming to the US soon
item.description: Wegovy's new pill has been approved in the US, offering a needle-free option with a lower starting price than injections.
